Choose a task you need, engineer the collaboration, complete it, and review the evidence.

## Learning goal

Produce a verified output from one bounded workflow and evaluate how the collaboration performed.

## Slides

- [A useful research workflow](../slides/workflow.qmd)

These decks are working teaching drafts. Slide text is available in the editable Quarto source.

## Main topics

- Task selection and explicit acceptance criteria
- Reusable skills, accessible inputs, and review points
- Verification of outputs and evidence for improvements

## Practice

Submit a task brief, workflow and skills, output and checks, application review, and a justified improvement or reasoned decision to retain the workflow.

Exercise details are proposals for instructor review. The final rubric and submission arrangements will accompany the teaching release.
